## What it checks (sampled describe/it titles)

- ExcelStructureEngine.analyze — empty + degenerate
- empty sheet → all-zero structure
- single text cell → row_count=1, col_count=1, no header
- ExcelStructureEngine.analyze — header detection
- detects header row when first row is all-text
- no header_row when first row has mixed text + numeric
